method.warm: Same BrowserContext after the cold destination; use browser Back to source, with same-context source-reload fallback if history does not restore the exact source path.
method.clickMarker: Node monotonic time captured by a page binding during trusted pointerdown on the exact destination anchor; Playwright action-start fallback is excluded from valid samples.
method.urlMarker: First animation-frame poll where location.pathname matches destination. Poll begins before click.
method.heroMarker: First animation-frame poll after destination path where a visible H1 contains the expected route title.
method.throttling: No CPU/network throttling; headless Chromium and Playwright Pixel 7 emulation.
